description: Major Safety and Security Events is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This is a list of all Major Safety and Security Events from January of 2014 to the most recently published data within the Federal Transit Administration's major event time series: Monthly Safety and Security data are released to this dataset within three months of being submitted to the NTD. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 127 columns, among them Person List, Mode Name, Other Serious Injuries, Non-Operator Transit Employee Injuries, Other Transit Vehicle Manufacturer Description, Transit Vehicle Manufacturer. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
